paper_style.palette_strategy: 方法图以淡桃、浅灰、橙边、蓝、淡绿、淡黄、淡紫组织模块；slot mask 使用彩色 attention overlay；similarity/attention matrix 使用绿—黄或蓝—绿连续色阶；结果曲线/柱图按 panel 使用蓝、黄、绿、橙 categorical palette。表格保持黑白并以粗体突出较优值。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: 表格规则、正文/caption、数学标签和部分图线为 PDF 对象；照片、slot masks、热图和部分曲线为嵌入栅格。全篇是 mixed vector-raster 排版，没有公开的可重建 PDF 版式源。
paper_style.style_consistency: 双栏正文与跨栏主图、Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 字体、partial-grid/booktabs-like 表规则及 paired rows 整体一致；附录小图与 qualitative grid 信息密度高，caption 对缩写、band、固定设置和不确定性的完整度不一致。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: Proposed CompSLOT framework. Given an image batch, we extract primitives for each image with a concept learning procedure. Then, we distill the sample-wise similarity from the primitive representations of the image batch into logits. Takeaway: This conceptual pair-wise similarity enables the model to make decisions by additionally considering low-dimensional concept combinations, rather than relying solely on high-dimensional features.

color.semantic_mapping: 白/淡桃/浅灰区分概念学习和模块容器，橙边、蓝、淡绿、淡黄、淡紫区分 slot、primitive、loss 与状态角色；Frozen/Learnable 另用文字 key。

encodings.x: 左到右 image batch→concept→primitive→similarity/logit 数据流
encodings.y: 上层主流与下层 slot/decoder 子流程
encodings.color: 模块角色与 Frozen/Learnable 状态
encodings.shape: 模块框、slot/primitive 符号与箭头端点
encodings.line: solid arrows for data and loss flow
encodings.facet: top pipeline plus lower slot-learning lane
encodings.text: module names, Lre/Lp/La/Lce, K and similarity labels

figures.data_and_statistics: 概念架构图；标出 image batch、primitive/logit similarity、K 和四类损失，但不表达样本量、聚合、分母或不确定性。
figures.evidence_relation: 引言关于跨任务共享概念的动机 → Figure 1 的 slot/primitive/logit 接口 → §4 的 Eq. (1)–(4) → Figure 2 的稳定性、Figure 4/9 的 similarity 证据与 Tables 1/7/8 的结果。
design_strengths: 全宽左到右路径把训练组件、输出和损失放到同一追踪面。
框色、箭头、位置、状态 key 和直接标签提供多重接口线索。
后续对象复用 primitive、logit、slot 和 loss 术语。
design_weaknesses: 模块/损失密集，小字号缩放后难读。
训练与 inference 的差异主要靠箭头和文本，灰度及色觉受限时角色区分下降。
没有显式给出 pairwise similarity 的张量尺寸或 batch 聚合。
figures.reusable_pattern: 用全宽架构图固定 image→slot→primitive→logit 接口，再让结果、消融和附录矩阵复用同一符号。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Examples of learned slots by continual COBJ reconstruction tasks and validation reconstruction losses. Left: slots are extracted for three example images from the first task on learners after training on the 1-st, 2-nd, and 3-rd tasks. Slots are masked with different colors. Middle: corresponding slot cosine similarity matrices grouped by correlated regions. Each group contains slots from three tasks and is identified by the Hungarian matching algorithm. Right: validation reconstruction loss matrix. Each row indicates a learner trained after a specific task and evaluated on all seen tasks, respectively. Takeaway: learned Slot Attention module enjoys almost no forgetting across compositional-relevant tasks.

color.semantic_mapping: slot mask 颜色区分区域；中部绿色色阶表达 slot cosine similarity，右侧 loss matrix 用连续值/颜色，任务和 group 标签提供位置冗余。

figures.evidence_relation: Figure 1 Slot Attention 分支 → Figure 2 的跨任务 slot/matching/loss 稳定性 → Figures 5–8 mask 扩展与 Figures 9–10 similarity chain；支持 almost no forgetting 的局部机制证据。
design_strengths: 样例、对齐矩阵和验证 loss 共享一条左到右阅读方向。

同一图同时连接 qualitative representation 与量化 loss。
design_weaknesses: 三种矩阵与多色 mask 信息密度高，缩放后色条和小字难读。

代表性图片的抽样规则和矩阵归一化细节未在 caption 给出。
figures.reusable_pattern: 把 qualitative mask、跨任务对齐关系矩阵和验证损失放在同一横向 evidence chain，避免只展示 attention 图。

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4: Concept learning visualization and fruits of primitive-logit knowledge distillation on COBJ. Left: Examples of visualization of learned slots that associated with the corresponding concepts after finish T0 and T1 tasks. Red color indicates a high value in slot attention masks. Middle: Primitive (comparing with ground truth concept) cosine similarity matrix for ADAM+adapter † on 30 images in T0 (left) and on additional 30 images in T1(right). Right: Logit cosine similarity for ADAM+adapter with and without CompSLOT on 30 images in T0. Takeaway: The learned primitive successfully mimics concept statistics and CompSLOT successfully distills pair-wise primitive similarity into logits. Red box shows evidences.

figures.label: Figure 9

caption.text: Figure 9: Visualization of a) concept; b) primitive; c) feature; d) logit cosine similarity matrices on sampled images (three images for each class in the first task T0 and second task T1 of the 10-10 tasks) on COBJ. a) Left: Multi-hot concept cosine similarity matrix of 30 images for T0; right: Multi-hot concept cosine similarity of 60 images (from the first-2 tasks T0 and T1). b) The primitive cosine similarity of the corresponding images. We use the learned pair-wise primitive similarity to mimic the statistics of the pair-wise concept similarity and regularize logits. c) Left: The learned feature cosine similarity matrix of 30 images in T0 for ADAM + adapter; right: The learned feature cosine similarity matrix of 30 images in T0 for ADAM + adapter †. d) The logit cosine similarity of the corresponding images as in c). Takeaway: The learned primitive successfully mimics concept statistics without concept supervision, and our La successfully distills pair-wise primitive similarity into logits and affects the feature representations (as demonstrated with the regions marked with red box), while ADAM + adapter does not capture this concept sharing statistic.

caption.text: Figure 10: Visualization of a) images related to red box; b) primitive; c) feature; d) logit cosine similarity matrices on sampled images (three images for each class in the first task T0 and second task T1 of the 20-20 tasks) on ImageNet-R. a) Six images from two classes in T0 which corresponding to the red box. b) The primitive cosine similarity of the corresponding images. c) Left: The learned feature cosine similarity matrix of 60 images in T0 for FOSTER; right: The learned feature cosine similarity matrix of 60 images in T0 for FOSTER †. d) The logit cosine similarity of the corresponding images as in c). cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 定义 image→slot→primitive→logit 接口；Figure 2 给出跨任务 slot stability；Table 1/Figure 3 建立 CGQA paired main comparison；Table 2/Figure 4 回到组件与 similarity 机制；Figures 5–10 扩展跨数据集 qualitative/matrix evidence；Tables 3–13、Figures 11–14 完成 hyperparameter、benchmark、backbone、finetuning 与成本边界。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 编号和标题格式稳定；Figure 1/2/4、Table 1/7/8 的 setup、encoding、comparison 较完整，Figure 11–13 与 Tables 2/6/10/11/13 多只有 title。主文 Figure 1/2/4 和 Figure 14 写出 finding，Figure 3 band 未定义；Figure 6 caption 复用错误的 CGQA 类别名，是明确的对象级不一致。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 主结果 Table 1/7 使用 Continual/CFST 二层 header 与 AA/CA/FF/Hn/R 方向指标，Table 5 用上下 block 拆 CFST 子测试；配置表使用 Hyper-parameters/Value 或 Methods/β/τa，成本表把小时单位写入 caption。粗体是主要高亮，几乎不使用 cell color/underline。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1 的 slot、primitive selection、Lp/La 数据流由 Table 1/7/8 的 paired learner results、Table 2 的 loss/weighting ablation、Figure 4/9 的 similarity matrices 和 Table 11 的 primitive-only counterexample 分层验证；Figure 13/Table 6 提供 β/τa sensitivity。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 主文 Figure 2/4 与 Table 1/2 通过正文和 section G/H 指向附录；Figures 5–10 复用 mask/matrix grammar，Tables 7–10 扩展 dataset/backbone，Tables 11–13 补 raw primitive、finetuning 和 cost，Figures 11–14 补 sensitivity/parameter count。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文、caption 和表格主要为 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern roman/math；表头与最优值 bold，表格主体约 7.5–9 pt，图内标签约 6–14 pt。qualitative grid 和 radar legend 在缩放后显著小于正文。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: Figure 1 的 module colors 与 Figures 2/4/9 的 green/blue similarity 语义有局部延续；mask 图颜色更偏 attention overlay，Figure 3/13/14 的方法色只在局部 panel 稳定；表格黑白高亮一致，但全篇颜色不保证灰度安全。

most_reusable_patterns: 用全宽 pipeline 固定 image→slot→primitive→logit vocabulary，并让结果/消融复用。
用样本/类别×task stage qualitative grid 固定 wp→image→sum→slots 列顺序。
用 concept→primitive→feature/logit 的同样本 matrix chain 把机制观察连接到 Lp/La ablation。
用 paired rows、二层 metric header 与 †/* key 将 plugin effect、rehearsal 和 benchmark extension 放到同一决策面。
将 total parameter paired bars 与 plugin-only/baseline/enhanced baseline time table 配对，显式限定成本边界。
failure_patterns: Figure 6 caption 把 COBJ 图中的类别误写为 Figure 5 的 CGQA 类别，是明确的 caption/layout mismatch。
qualitative grids 依赖选择性样例且没有 failure/variation；Figure 3 band 没有统计定义。
多数附录表/敏感性图缺 seed、重复、区间或 fixed-parameter context。
小字号、密集矩阵和 radar legend 在页面缩放后可读性下降，颜色整体不是灰度安全。
Table 6 的 Varing、Table 12 的 on Finetuning on 和 Figure 13 对 bar panel 的 line-chart 命名显示编辑/ caption 复核不足。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文用稳定的 slot/primitive/logit 词汇贯穿架构、paired benchmark、机制矩阵、qualitative grid 与成本附录，形成从方法接口到证据边界的视觉叙事，但公开仓库仅有 Figure 1 的 rendered diagram asset，且附录 caption 与不确定性定义仍不足以独立重建全部对象。
